title: Certificates of Deposit: start and maturity dates of a term renewed after grace
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when a Certificates of Deposit certificate renews into its own tier after the grace period. It fixes the start date and the maturity date of the new term.

## Rule

1. **Start.** The new term starts on the old maturity date, not on the day the renewal is booked.
2. **Maturity.** The new term matures the tier's term length in calendar months after that start date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist in the maturity month.

## Illustrative dates (hypothetical maturity dates and term lengths)

| Old maturity date | Renewal booked on | Hypothetical term length | New term start | New maturity date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June 2026 | 21 June 2026 | 12 months | 10 June 2026 | 10 June 2027 |
| 31 August 2026 | 11 September 2026 | 6 months | 31 August 2026 | 28 February 2027 |
| 31 August 2027 | 11 September 2027 | 6 months | 31 August 2027 | 29 February 2028 |
| 30 November 2026 | 11 December 2026 | 3 months | 30 November 2026 | 28 February 2027 |

## Points of judgement

**The renewal is booked eleven days after maturity. Does the new term start on the booking day?**
No. The new term starts on the old maturity date, so the term start date lies before the booking day.

**What if the month of maturity is shorter than the start day?**
The maturity date falls back to the last day of that month, as in the 31 August examples above.
